#1 travel — the frame itself warps: the square rotates 0.42 rad and shifts hue (the turn the flat arrangement cannot preserve); the annotator's ✎ becomes ▦ — pieces become local charts; turbulence up (travel's disturbance); pointer vortex with shove — the question forcing the frame.

#2 circle — ring layout (the circle example): the overlap rule v=1/u becomes the crossing point (3/5,4/5) moved onto the chart's rim; dv becomes −2/9; the agreed height 4/5 steady at the left; slow field — the matheme read carefully; duration 14.

#2b torus — THE 3D SCENE. z is the loop's lift: the presenting square base at z −0.3, the generating loop at z 0, the displaced endpoint (2,−1)→[2t,−t] nearest at z +0.35 — you see the return and its winding separated in depth; vortex3d + loop LFO on circulation; pointer vortex/vortex; duration 15.

#4 marble — the planet appears: the blue disc grows from dim to full (the image arriving), the box-lid square held faint (the reading refused dominance), the diaphanous ring bright (conditions readable within use), ? bright between them; pointer attract/implode — the image gathering the gaze; slow speed LFO (the planet's turn).

#5→0 return — the atlas yantra unfolds a half-turn (the means to revise travelling beside the map); the first picture reopened (square brighter than the box-lid ever was in #4's dark); Mapper and A32 bright at the edges; pointer near-still attract.
